summary: Replaced the process-wide settings with an immutable Settings value and settings.make(), passed as the first parameter `conf` through all code that needs it, with the entry-point signatures from the guide; cache keys now include the settings by value and import-time reads (units, dim divisor, closed days, freight minimum, cached fuel/fx/zone results) were removed. Tests were moved to the new API and pass; CLI output matched the original on 406 randomized runs and library calls with several settings in one process matched too. TextTable keeps its fixed width of 72 because the original CLI never applied line_width to tables.
